references.text: Moses went up the mountain and stayed there for forty days and forty nights, which explains why the people thought he was delaying in coming down.
Aaron relayed the people's words to Moses, confirming that they said they did not know what had happened to Moses.
Moses reminds the people that he was on the mountain for forty days and forty nights.
In his speech, Stephen quotes the people's words when they asked Aaron to make gods to go before them because they did not know what had happened to Moses.
The psalm describes how the Israelites made a calf at Horeb and worshiped a cast image.
The Lord went before the people in a pillar of cloud by day and a pillar of fire by night, and now the people want a replacement for this divine guidance.
The people break the second commandment by asking that an idol be made for them.
